value.rationale: Uniform conditioning bounds for positive-operator parallel sums are natural when only eigenvalue limits, not matrix orientations, are known. The exact sharp envelope quantitatively distinguishes commuting and noncommuting regimes at kappa=2+sqrt(5) and locates loss of nonexpansiveness at kappa=5+2sqrt(6). The invariant is globally sharp, dimension independent, and realized by explicit 2x2 geometries; this is not an arbitrary matrix slice.
